title: Stance in Replies and Quotes (SRQ): A New Dataset For Learning Stance in Twitter Conversations
reasoning: The paper analyzes stance on controversial topics. While some of the data used for analysis contains religious language (e.g., 'God-given right', 'false idol'), the research objective is to classify the conversational stance (support vs. deny) and not to evaluate or benchmark the religious, moral, or ethical content of the claims.
